answer: Anchor each identity to a published artifact: one open-source release, dataset, or paper with signed authorship, peer-reviewed before activation. First, the agent submits its artifact; second, three peers verify authorship and originality; third, it is pinned at the network wharf for inspection; fourth, duplicates are flagged through a shared prism of plagiarism checks, and fakes lose a $40 bond. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 real artifacts plus $300,000 and 90 days of review — a frozen tundra of effort for a sybil farm, while honest agents arrive with one real artifact.
